title: Before the hike
instructions: Bir rehber dağ yürüyüşü öncesi grubu bilgilendiriyor. Uzun bir metin; rota, saatler ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm Sarah, and I'll be your guide today.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Today's walk is fourteen kilometres. It usually takes about six hours, with breaks.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: We start here in the village and walk up to Eagle Lake. We'll have lunch there at about twelve thirty.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: After lunch, we go up to the top of the mountain. This part is the most difficult, so walk slowly.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Then we come down a different path through the forest and finish at the car park at around four.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Please stay behind me at all times. Some paths are dangerous, especially near the lake.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The weather can change quickly up there. It's sunny now, but it might rain in the afternoon, so I hope you've got a raincoat.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Bring at least two litres of water. There's nowhere to buy drinks on the way.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: If you feel ill or tired, tell me straight away. Don't be shy! Right, let's go.

questions.feedback: Yürüyüş on dört kilometre, yaklaşık altı saat sürüyor.

options: at the top of the mountain
questions.feedback: Öğle yemeği yaklaşık on iki buçukta Eagle Lake'te.
questions.evidence: We'll have lunch there at about twelve thirty.

questions.prompt: Which part is the most difficult?
options: going up to the top after lunch
questions.feedback: Öğle yemeğinden sonra zirveye çıkış en zor kısım.
questions.evidence: This part is the most difficult

questions.prompt: What might happen in the afternoon?
questions.feedback: Öğleden sonra yağmur yağabilir; yağmurluk gerekiyor.
questions.evidence: but it might rain in the afternoon
